art_direction: Premium Indian agricultural export brand. Editorial, harvest-inspired, deep-green eco luxury. The design must feel grounded yet highly premium, combining the organic nature of agriculture with the precision of international logistics.

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3. Use tracking-tighter for large sizes (text-5xl to text-6xl+). Never use generic sans fonts for headings. Use italic weights occasionally for emphasis (e.g., 'Premium Indian Products. *Global Quality.*').

body.usage: Paragraphs, navigation, product specs, buttons, forms, and data tables. Clean and modern to contrast the serif headings.

primary.description: Deep Forest Green. Used for dark mode sections, primary buttons, footers.

secondary.description: Warm Bone/Sand. The default background for light mode sections.

accent.description: Harvest Gold. Used for badges, highlights, 'Request a Quote' CTAs, and active states.

rules: Never use pure black or pure white. Always use tinted neutrals.
Avoid heavy gradients. Use solid colors or very subtle noise/grain textures.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all text over backgrounds.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or floating navigation.

layouts_and_spacing.grid_system: The 'Bento Tetris' Grid for marketing sections. Use asymmetric grids (e.g., col-span-8 and col-span-4 combinations).
layouts_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-12, p-16, p-24 for section padding. Do not cram elements together.
layouts_and_spacing.section_rhythm: Alternate between Dark (Deep Forest Green) and Light (Warm Bone) backgrounds for clear section delineation.
layouts_and_spacing.image_treatment: Use clipped frames (rounded corners with distinct radii like rounded-tl-[4rem] rounded-br-[4rem]) or sharp rectangles with 1px borders. Never use heavy drop shadows on images.

motion_and_interaction.hero_animation: Kinetic typography with masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion.
motion_and_interaction.scroll_effects: Subtle parallax on background images. Elements should fade and slide up slightly on scroll.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Buttons should lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and change to a brighter/darker shade. Product cards should have image scale on hover.
motion_and_interaction.marquee: One slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee or CSS keyframes, displaying export destinations or product categories.

components_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md). 'Request a Quote' should be the primary accent (Harvest Gold). 'Add to Enquiry Basket' can be outline or secondary.
components_strategy.navigation: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F7F5F0]/80 (or dark equivalent). Must include Language (EN/HI) and Currency (USD/INR) toggles, and Wishlist/Cart icons.
components_strategy.product_card: Minimalist. High-quality image, subtle border, heading in Cormorant, specs in Manrope. CTA: 'View Details' or 'Add to Quote'.
components_strategy.rfq_form: Clean, multi-step or well-organized form using Shadcn UI inputs. High contrast borders.
components_strategy.whatsapp_float: Fixed bottom-right circular button with a green WhatsApp brand color (#25D366) or integrated into the brand's Deep Green. Must ping +91 9214315956.

Home.Hero: Kinetic text, dark overlay on harvest image, 'Premium Indian Products. Global Quality.'
Home.Manifesto: Numbered chapters (01 Rice, 02 Bagasse, 03 Foxnut) with asymmetric layout.
Home.Marquee: Slow moving text showing export markets.
Home.Categories: Bento grid of the 3 product lines.

Products (Catalog).Filters: Sidebar or top bar for categories (Rice, Bagasse, Foxnut).
Products (Catalog).Cards: Show basic specs and 'Add to Quote' button. Hide prices.

Product_Detail.Layout: Left: Sticky Image Gallery. Right: Product Title, Specs (moisture, broken %, HSN), Packaging, MOQ, 'Add to Enquiry', 'WhatsApp Enquiry'.
Product_Detail.Details: Use Shadcn Tabs or Accordion for detailed specifications.

pages_blueprint.About_Us: Story-driven, editorial layout. Focus on the Gorakhpur origin and global reach.
pages_blueprint.Export_Markets: Interactive or static world map, or clean list of countries with flag icons.
pages_blueprint.Certifications: Grid of certification logos (ISO, APEDA, FSSAI, etc. - use placeholders if unavailable) with minimal borders.
pages_blueprint.Contact_Us: Two columns: Contact Info (Mr. Suraj Panday & Mr. Prajapati Raviprakash, +91 9214315956, starvestaworldwide@gmail.com) and an Enquiry Form.

hero_harvest.description: Wheat harvest sunrise. Use for Hero background with bg-black/40 overlay.

product_rice.description: Premium basmati rice grains. Use for Rice Category card/header.

product_bagasse.description: White eco-friendly bagasse plates. Use for Bagasse Category.

product_foxnut.description: Foxnut/Makhana close up. Use for Foxnut Category.

logistics_export.description: Aerial view of cargo ship. Use for Export Markets or About Us section.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, form submissions, language toggles, currency toggles) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., 'data-testid="add-to-quote-button"').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT output generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Push for editorial, spacious, high-end layouts.
NEVER center-align the main app container. Do NOT add '.App { text-align: center; }' in CSS.
NEVER use 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transitions (e.g., 'transition-colors', 'transition-transform').
Never use AI assistant emojis (🤖, 💡, 🎯, etc.) for UI icons. Use lucide-react or standard SVG icons.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in the root layout.
When placing text over images (Hero), always apply a contrast overlay (e.g., bg-black/40) or text-shadow.
Customize scrollbars to hide gutters (hide scrollbar standard styling).
Prioritize Shadcn/UI for functional elements (Forms, Dropdowns, Tabs, Dialogs) but strip generic Vercel styling to match the Deep Green / Bone White brand palette.
Ensure the Language (EN/HI) and Currency (USD/INR) toggles are highly visible in the top navigation.
Write all React code in standard `.jsx` or `.js` files, NO `.tsx`.
